2607.14791.title: Transcoders for Investigating Deception in Language Models
2607.14791.paper_summary: Transcoders have recently emerged as a promising approach for mechanistic interpretability (MI), enabling circuit-level analysis of model behaviour. In this paper, we investigate the use of transcoders to analyse deceptive behaviour in language models, a behaviour that poses a safety and security risk. Using a Qwen3-4B model with pre-trained transcoders, specifically per-layer transcoders (PLTs), we construct attribution graphs that capture feature activations and inter-feature dependencies, allowing circuit-level analysis of deception. Through feature steering and circuit analysis, we identified a dictionary of deception-related features and show that these features exert a stronger influence on deceptive outputs, as they produce predictable shifts between deceptive and non-deceptive responses. These findings suggest that deception emerges from internal model mechanisms and highlight the potential of transcoders for behavioural monitoring and early detection of security vulnerabilities related to malicious behaviours in language models.
2607.14791.paper_summary_zh: 轉碼器最近作為機械解釋性（MI）的一種有前景的方法出現，能夠對模型行為進行電路級分析。<lb/>在這篇論文中，我們研究了使用轉碼器來分析語言模型中的欺騙行為，這種行為構成了安全風險。<lb/>使用一個預訓練轉碼器的Qwen3-4B模型，特別是每層轉碼器（PLTs），我們構建了捕捉特徵激活和特徵間依賴性的歸因圖，允許對欺騙行為進行電路級分析。<lb/>通過特徵引導和電路分析，我們識別出一個與欺騙相關的特徵字典，並顯示這些特徵對欺騙輸出施加了更強的影響，因為它們在欺騙和非欺騙反應之間產生可預測的轉變。<lb/>這些發現表明，欺騙源於內部模型機制，並突顯了轉碼器在行為監測和早期檢測與語言模型中的惡意行為相關的安全漏洞方面的潛力。
